intro.paragraph1: Studioz ("the Company" or "we") is committed to making its website and digital services accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities, so that all users can enjoy equal, dignified, accessible, and independent use to the greatest extent possible.
intro.paragraph2: This accessibility statement was prepared in accordance with the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations (Accessibility Adjustments for Service), 5773-2013, and Israeli Standard SI 5568 based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA.

general.title: General Service Information
general.paragraph1: The Studioz website (www.studioz.co.il) is a digital platform for discovering, booking, and managing creative studio spaces in Israel. The service is provided primarily online.
general.address: Address: 70 Allenby Street, Tel Aviv, Israel

commitment.title: Our Commitment to Accessibility
commitment.paragraph1: We place high importance on accessibility and work continuously to improve the user experience for everyone, especially people with visual, hearing, motor, cognitive, and other disabilities.
commitment.paragraph2: Accessibility is implemented at the code, structure, content, and user-assistance layers — and does not rely on external overlays alone. The on-site accessibility panel is a helpful supplement, not a substitute for standards-compliant accessibility.

conformance.title: Conformance Status
conformance.paragraph1: The website aims to meet SI 5568 and WCAG 2.1 Level AA requirements.
conformance.paragraph2: "Partially Conformant" means some parts of the content or functionality do not yet fully meet the standard, as described in the "Known Limitations" section below. We are working to close these gaps on an ongoing basis.

websiteMeasures.title: Website Accessibility Measures
websiteMeasures.intro: The following accessibility measures have been implemented on the site:

items.bilingual: Bilingual site (Hebrew and English) with appropriate lang and dir attributes.
items.semantic: Semantic HTML structure: headings, navigation, main content, and footer landmarks.
items.skipLinks: Skip links to main content, navigation, and footer.
items.toolbar: Built-in accessibility panel: font size, high contrast, stop animations, link highlighting, text spacing, large cursor, and keyboard navigation highlight.
items.aria: ARIA attributes on interactive interfaces (labels, states, live regions, and more).
items.routeAnnouncer: SPA route-change announcements for screen readers.
items.forms: Form field labels, accessible error display, and error association with relevant fields.
items.modals: Focus management in modal dialogs, including focus trap and focus restoration on close.
items.images: Required alternative text (alt) for content images.
items.keyboard: Keyboard navigation support and visible focus indicators (:focus-visible).
items.cookies: Accessible cookie consent mechanism with preference management.

physicalAccess.title: Physical Accessibility
physicalAccess.paragraph1: Studioz's primary service is digital. The Company's offices at 70 Allenby Street, Tel Aviv are not open to the general public on a walk-in basis.
physicalAccess.paragraph2: Office meetings are by appointment only. People with disabilities who wish to meet in person are asked to contact us in advance so we can arrange appropriate accessibility accommodations, including assistance with entry, seating, and communication.

assistiveTech.title: Assistive Technology Compatibility
assistiveTech.intro: The site was evaluated through self-assessment using the following browsers and technologies (current versions as of the assessment date):
assistiveTech.note: Compatibility may vary between browser versions, operating systems, and assistive software. If you encounter a specific issue, please contact us.

knownLimitations.title: Known Limitations
knownLimitations.intro: Despite ongoing efforts, the following areas are known to be only partially accessible:

items.partialConformance: The site is partially conformant with WCAG 2.1 AA; remediation work is ongoing.
items.contrast: Not all color combinations have been systematically verified; some may not meet the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
items.iconButtons: Some icon-only buttons may need improved screen reader labels.
items.fieldsets: Grouping related form fields with fieldset/legend is not yet complete everywhere.
items.tables: Tables in dashboards (e.g., documents, orders) may require additional accessibility improvements.
items.thirdParty: Third-party content and components (maps, payments, authentication) may depend on the external provider's accessibility level.
items.userContent: Studio accessibility descriptions are entered by studio owners and may be inaccurate or incomplete.
items.automatedTesting: Automated accessibility CI testing has not yet been fully implemented.

knownLimitations.closing: We address these items as part of our ongoing roadmap and update this statement accordingly.

feedback.title: Feedback and Requests
feedback.paragraph1: We welcome your feedback if you encounter an accessibility barrier, need help accessing information or services, or have suggestions for improvement.

requestItems.description: A description of the barrier or issue encountered
requestItems.page: The page URL where the issue occurred
requestItems.contact: Your contact details for a response

feedback.paragraph3: We commit to reviewing your request and responding within 5 business days. Complex cases may require additional time; we will keep you informed.
feedback.paragraph4: If your request is not resolved to your satisfaction, you may contact the Accessibility Coordinator (details below) or use the enforcement channel described in "Enforcement and Appeals".

coordinator.title: Accessibility Coordinator
coordinator.intro: For accessibility-related inquiries, requests, and suggestions:
coordinator.name: Darnell Green (דרנל גרין)

methods.selfEvaluation: Internal self-evaluation by the development team
methods.codeReview: Code and UI review against WCAG 2.1 AA and SI 5568
methods.manualTesting: Manual testing with keyboard and screen readers (VoiceOver, NVDA)

enforcement.title: Enforcement and Appeals
enforcement.paragraph1: If your inquiry to the Accessibility Coordinator is not resolved to your satisfaction, you may contact the Commission for Equal Rights of Persons with Disabilities:
enforcement.commissionName: Commission for Equal Rights of Persons with Disabilities
enforcement.paragraph2: You may also contact other relevant public service channels depending on the nature of your request.

related.termsAccessibilityNote: A brief accessibility section also appears in the Terms of Service; this document is the full accessibility statement.
